build_learnableblur_module: build a LearnableBlur module that applies learnable weighted blur combinations to images based on camera names
create_learnableblur_instance: create a LearnableBlur instance with a list of camera names to initialize per-camera blur weights
test_forward_blur: test the LearnableBlur forward pass by passing an image tensor and camera names list
review_name_to_idx: review the LearnableBlur name_to_idx method that maps camera names to their index positions
refactor_reg_method: refactor the LearnableBlur reg method to return raw blur weights for specified cameras
